title: Register a new account and land on the home experience
description: Verifies a new user can register with valid credentials and is redirected into the app upon success.

steps.description: Navigate to /register
Fill valid text into the username field
Fill a unique valid email into the email field
Fill a password that meets the minimum requirements into the password field
Submit the registration form
Verify the user lands on the home page

Click the shelf tab for read
